description: Heard the walking from first light, and was not given a side.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Named the hearse, accepted the second act, and kept the account at three pence.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed at the foot of the stair, and did not ask the king's name.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Answered, sat, and refused a third act.
name: William Shakespeare
